messages:
Anya: tossed a new wrinkle into the SLO guardrail convo. trying a small prototype where when guardrail trips we offer a two-second undo and a subtle haptic microfeedback on supported devices. dropped the prototype link in drive. thoughts?
Jess: interesting. i like the undo (less scary than blocking). microcopy needs to explain what happened: e.g., 'SLO set outside recommended range. Auto-applied safe value. Undo?'. short and scannable.
Mike: UX nit: if we auto-apply a safe value we should show the delta and cost impact inline: '-2 GPUs, est +$0.05/hr'. otherwise people won't trust the change. also the haptic is nice for phone but don't surface it on web.
Ben: backend constraints: auto-apply means we actually write a different min value to the model config. we must flag that as an auto-correction event and include original requested value in the audit log. will add an `auto_correct` field.
Sam: a11y: undo must be keyboard accessible and announced by screen readers. suggestion: when auto-correct runs, put an alert role="status" message: 'SLO set outside recommended range. Value adjusted to X. Press undo to revert.' aria-live=polite is fine.
Lili: i18n concern: the 2-second undo toast is tight for localized strings which can be much longer in other languages. we should either extend timeout for locales based on length or allow the toast to persist until dismissed on mobile.
Jess: good call. also the label 'Undo' may not translate to clear action in all languages; include icon + text.
Mike: animation/accessibility: if we animate the cost delta, respect prefers-reduced-motion and provide an instant number change fallback.
Ben: policy note: if user intentionally overrides guardrail after undo window, we still record override and prompt for a short reason. that flow needs to exist.
Anya: design question: should undo revert user input and keep focus on the control or move focus to Save? i'm leaning keep focus on the control so users can re-tweak.
Sam: definitely keep focus on control. announce via aria-live that value was reverted and read the current value. ensure focus isn't lost.
Lili: locale formatting: cost delta should use user's locale currency formatting and decimals. backend will provide cents, frontend should format.
Jess: microcopy proposal for toast: 'Adjusted to recommended value to protect SLOs. Undo' with secondary tiny link 'Why this change?'. longer explanation can open side panel.
Mike: also suggest a tiny 'preview' mode where dragging shows predicted QoS and cost on a small two-line card, updated live but non-committal until Save. this helps people explore without triggering autosaves or guardrails.
Ben: we can expose that easily by separating client-only preview and server validation on Save. just make sure preview uses same model for cost calc as save to avoid surprises.
Anya: action items: Jess finalize toast copy with localization notes, Sam add aria-live snippets and keyboard guidance, Lili to propose locale timeout heuristic, Mike to prototype preview card and reduced-motion behavior, Ben to add auto_correct telemetry fields. i'll wire up prototype and loop back. :thumbsup:
design-bot: prototype link: https://www.figma.com/file/protoSLO/guardrail-undo-proto frame: 'UndoToast-v1'
Anya: thanks all, great input. I'll push an updated figma and a short demo video tomorrow.
